kind: ADDITIVE and IMMUTABLE. One single-variable experiment. rev4b, rev4c, their addenda, receipts and reports are NOT mutated

ARCHITECTURAL_FRAMING_BINDING.single_variable: REV4D differs from REV4B in EXACTLY ONE dimension: trace_repeat 4 -> 1. Prefix length, negative-ankle coverage, labelling, init, anchor, aggregation operator and every July hyperparameter are byte-identical to rev4b
ARCHITECTURAL_FRAMING_BINDING.reference_arm: REV4B (prefix 392, repeat 4, share 75.8221%, 65 distinct negative indices, survival 42). REV4D holds the prefix and the coverage and changes only the weight
ARCHITECTURAL_FRAMING_BINDING.what_it_deconfounds: rev4c lowered the on-policy share by CUTTING the prefix from 392 to 68, which moved the share AND the negative-ankle coverage together (65 -> 9 distinct indices, 5 windows -> 1). REV4D lowers the share while holding coverage at the maximum available from the S1A trace, so the two axes separate
what_it_is_NOT: NOT a replication of any July round: no July configuration used prefix 392 with repeat 1
NOT a promotion of any kind
NOT a sigma decision: the logstd placeholder is carried unchanged and is never interpreted as a choice of sigma
ARCHITECTURAL_FRAMING_BINDING.declared_residual_confound: trace_repeat controls the on-policy weight AND the duplicate leakage across the validation split, which adapt_actor draws as a seeded random permutation over the aggregate (target_domain_imitation.py:846-852). With repeat 4 the probability that a unique on-policy row has copies on both sides is 0.5895 for the rev4b aggregate; with repeat 1 it is exactly 0. The two are not separable inside that parameter. Therefore the primary gate is CLOSED-LOOP survival and offline validation MSE is diagnostic only, never a promotion criterion

primary_gate.rationale: 116 is the best result already obtained by the repeat-4 / interpolation-0 family (rev4c). Exceeding it is the only evidence that changing the repeat operator adds something beyond what rev4c already showed

interpretation_grid.above_116: at a moderate share the coverage helps: the rev4c reading was confounded
interpretation_grid.about_116: the share is the lever and the coverage is inert: the rev4c conclusion survives deconfounding
interpretation_grid.about_42: neither share nor coverage but the tiling operator at full prefix is harmful

CRITERIA.no_automatic_promotion: even if every criterion passes, the candidate is NOT promoted; the architect decides after the audit

tooling_requirements.parameterised_labels: actor labels must be parameterised in KEYS and in PROSE. The seven-gate meaning string inherited from the frozen S1B tool must be rewritten with this actor's label at write time; the frozen tool is not modified
tooling_requirements.regression_tests: must prove the key scan, the new prose scan and the rewritten meaning string
